snippet.title: Dragon Fire Ice Melt - Trailer
snippet.description:
We made Dragon Fire Ice Melt in a few days for the No ICE in MN charity bundle. You play as a dragon breathing fire to melt the incoming ice storm, and free the imprisoned baby dragons.

Charity bundle: https://itch.io/b/3484/no-ice-in-minnesota
Game page: https://dragonsisle.itch.io/dragon-fire-ice-melt
